schema.description: Specifies relationships between the current document and an external resource.

href.description: A URL. Specifies the location of the linked document.

objectType.description: The type of the object, link.

schema.title: link

description:
The user’s profile can be accessed through a direct self‑link at **https://api.example.com/v1/users/12345/profile**. This link is of type **application/json** and should be retrieved using an HTTP **GET** request. It is defined as a **link** object whose relationship to the current document is “self”, indicating that it points back to the resource it describes.

For documentation purposes, the link is titled **“User Profile”**, making clear that the response will contain the personal details of user 12345 in JSON format.
